lines.text: The LORD judges Damascus for threshing Gilead, and fire will fall on the house of Jehu.
The LORD sends fire on Gaza and Tyre for delivering exiles to Edom, and Tyre broke a covenant of brotherhood.
The Ammonites ripped open Gilead's pregnant women to enlarge their territory, so Rabbah burns and their king goes into exile.
Moab burned to lime the bones of Ammon's king, and fire will fall on Judah for rejecting the Law.
